body.name: known-treatment--covariate-marginal experiment
body.construction: \(\mathcal E^{\mathrm{known}}_{n,d,\epsilon}:=\{(P^{\otimes n},P_{XA}):P\in\mathcal M_{d,\epsilon},\ n\ge1,\ d\ge2\}\), where the first coordinate generates \(\mathcal L_n\) and the second coordinate is the exact \(2d\)-cell table observed as deterministic side information.
